reviews.review_description: Uncommon Solar responded quickly to our request for information and a quote for installation of battery and panels. Options were provided and discussed and the whole process was pressure free.Once we had made the decision and committed, installation happened within 3 weeks. The team was very professional. They solved a couple of tricky issues related to the site and had the full installation completed inside the day. They left everything neat and tidy when they left.Uncommon Solar's post installation customer service was excellent with clear explanations of how to operate and track the system as well as organising the grid connection.

Uncommon Solar, Matt and Helen, have been a wonderful support for my 5 year old system when the envoy stopped working. Despite being extremely busy, they both made time, on the phone and in person, to help understand the problem, resulting in a new envoy being sent out. Cannot fault their service ethic, absolutely brilliant. Highly recommend!!

From the start uncommon solar was great to communicate and easy to deal with.install was quick and withing 1-2 weeks on quate approval.no rush when the quote was received you can act in your own time with no hassles.would happily recommend them to anyone.

Our dealings with Uncommon Solar were faultless right from the quote to the installation.We had to shift install dates due to weather, not a problem, Helen in the office made sure we were accommodated.Kenan on the pre installation check, explained everything clearly and answered all questions.Kenan's team on install day were on time, provided excellent communication and did an amazing job, a very professional team.The tutorial by David as to how it all works was too easy, we look forward to our system being inspected and switched onI will recommend this business.

I contacted Uncommon Solar knowing that they served the Eastern part of the state hoping that he could recommend someone over the Western suburbs to install a Powerwall expansion pack.Matt told me he could help me out that night had the quote and it was installed all within a week. The guys who installed the unit were fantastic it was done in about a hour and a half. I would not hesitate to recommend Matt and the guys at Uncommon Solar very professional company

A huge thanks to Matt and the team at Uncommon Solar for the installation of our 2 x Powerwall 3's. We were extremely happy with the service, the installation is neat and tidy and the installation team was extremely helpful.Would recommended Uncommon Solar for your battery installation.

We recently added an extra Enphase 5P battery through Uncommon Solar and the experience was just as smooth and professional as our first install. Our original system was done by G-Store, so it was a pleasant surprise to learn the staff had worked there before they closed. It felt like a bit of continuity we hadn’t expected but really appreciated.Clear communication from quoting, to booking, a tidy install, and they organised the inspection for grid connection.We’re now looking ahead to the Enphase Bi-Directional Charger release in 2026 or so to complete our setup and we’ll be booking Uncommon Solar again when it’s available.
Very pleased with Uncommon Solar but less impressed with the delay of inspection andconclusion of approval.
They installed a quality system. Great service and value. Wonderful ongoing advice

We've just had a Tesla Powerwall 3 and solar panel system installed by Matt and the team. It's been really well done and hassle free. It's doing everything we expected and makes us almost completely immune to the frequent power outages in our area. Highly recommended.

I was motivated to explore the cost benefit of a home battery system considering the new government subsidy, less feed-in tariffs and to address reducing the reliance on the power grid especially the “frequent” power outages in our area. We have an existing 11.75 kw/hr solar system with micro inverters.After a google search I settled on a few providers and installers including Uncommon Solar. Matt was helped me make an informed decision for a system that both met my requirements. Throughout the quote and consultation process Matt was very open about the different brands, the pros and cons which help us make our decision. Matt was always quick to respond to our enquiries which were numerous. Uncommon Solar are not affiliated with any particular brand or if they are, I’m not aware as at no point did I feel pressured to make a decision based on one brand. This is a strong aspect of Uncommon Solar in a home battery market that is very confusing given the choice of brands, sizes and features. I decided to go with Tesla Powerwall 3 with expansion pack.After a few frustrating few months of delay due to regulator approval, (no fault of Uncommon Solar). the installation day arrived and the Uncommon Solar installers arrived and the system was up and running by the early afternoon (then switched off awaiting inspection which only took a week). It was a very clean install. The team were keen to make sure the appropriate backup power system met our needs including a real time test. They showed me the features and a run down how the system worked and ran.Overall the experience, from consultation, quote, communication flow, and post installation support (which hasn’t needed to be any really), has been superb.I would highly recommend Uncommon Solar for your home battery needs.

I spoke to Matt over the phone to get an idea on what it was worth to update our old solar system (16 years old ) to a new system with batteries he gave me a quote over the phone after asking a few questions. I agreed and he come for a site inspection and we fine tuned a few things and from then he done the rest. The installation went perfect over 3 days removed old system and took it away then installed new panels and batteries set it all up on our tablet to see what the system was doing and how to operate everything.All paperwork was done from his end I only had to sign a few bits of paperwork - he did the restExcellent service with no stress on our side.

Uncommon Solar was very good from first contact to completion of installation.From helping select which product to use, quoting, helping with all the paper work, advising time frames to installation.Both heat pump hot water and solar were installed to what appears a very good quality installation, neat and tidy and with in a good time frameAll staff very helpful and friendly.Would have no hesitation in recommending Uncommon Solar to others.64

Quoting service was done and dusted the day we rang up for a quote.Any questions that we had were answered straight away.The quote with all details was sent through that evening.Installation and connections all went smoothly, without a hitch.Great company to deal with.

Awesome experience with Matt over many years with all things energy.  Great support with our Enphase Microinverter system, adding more panels, adding a battery, then another, and communicating at all times.  Never pushing for a sale, just wanting the best for me. Any question or issue is responded to within hours. Highly recommend.

Probably the most professional company we have dealt with. Every question we asked was answered in a way you could understand    We decided on the system Greg recommended. Installation was truly professionally done by Josh. We are very with all the team at Uncommon Solar.

The system that was suggested has, so far, surpassed our expectations. The install was smooth and tidy and the finished job looks great. Matt was always available to talk trough any questions we had and kept us up to date on the installation progress. Thanks to Uncommon SolarMatt and Jacob for getting us sorted.

I had an awesome experience with Uncommon Solar from start to finish. Their team made the entire process of installing our solar panels and battery system seamless and stress-free. From the initial consultation to the final setup, they were professional, transparent, and incredibly knowledgeable, guiding us every step of the way. The installation was smooth, and we’re already saving plenty on our electricity bills thanks to our tailored solar and battery solution. I highly recommend Uncommon Solar to anyone looking to go solar with a reliable, local company that truly cares about its customers!

The sales quoting process is very quick and they explain the details of the quote so that we have good understanding.The installation is very punctual, the staff are polite, the way that they do the job is very tidy.The customer service before and after the sales are excellent. I am very happy with all the service that Uncommon Solar provided and I have informed all of my network to choose Uncommon Solar for services related to solar panel and battery.

We have used Uncommon Solar since thy took over our previous supplier, The service and support have been brilliant.We had an inverter fail on our system and this has been replaced by Uncommon Solar organising everything. Installation and re programming the system done very well by the Uncommon Solar team. I would highly recommend them.Gary
Matt from Uncommon Solar was helpful and informative. He quoted accurately, explained things carefully and patiently and answered all our questions along the way. I highly recommend Uncommon Solar.

Matt and Helen from Uncommon Solar made the process of installing a Tesla Powerwall 3 simple. They managed all the required battery rebate paperwork etc.The installation design was customized to my requirements without any problems.  The installation tradesman was on time, very professional and neat.Powerwall 3 and 9 panels added to existing 21 panel Enphase Micro Inverter installation.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Uncommon Solar, and I couldn't be more impressed with the entire experience. From start to finish, everything was seamless. The team was professional, knowledgeable, and delivered exactly what they promised, without any hiccups along the way.The installation of my Tesla Powerwall 3 and SunPower solar panels was handled by skilled tradespeople who were efficient and meticulous. It was clear that they take pride in their work, and I felt confident every step of the way.The process was smooth, with clear communication, timely updates, and no surprises. The system works perfectly, and I can already see the benefits of having top-tier solar energy in place.I highly recommend Uncommon Solar to anyone looking for high-quality solar solutions and exceptional service. They definitely exceeded my expectations!

It was a very informative first meeting and it was nice that Matt was assessing our needs for a suitable system. After the quote was received we were explained how everything would proceed and my word Uncommon Solar stuck to everything they promised. Their very dedicated and friendly team installed 16 solar panels and. Tesla 3 powerwall system. The installers were very courteous and polite but you could see they enjoyed their work. The whole system is up and running and Matt came to set up my retailer and also the app on my mobile. Everything has been explained to me very well and now I am checking things on my mobile and learning how to  use the system. My system is also connected remotely to Matt’s mobile so he can initially keep tabs on my system to see that everything works well. I am very pleased with the whole service received so far. I can only recommend Uncommon Solar to anyone that wants to go or is already using solar.

We recently had a Tesla Powerwall 3 & Expansion Battery installed by the team at Uncommon Solar and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. A huge thanks to Matt for his quick turnaround, fantastic pricing and excellent communication from start to finish. The whole process was smooth and stress-free and the install was completed even faster than expected.This isn’t the first time we’ve worked with Matt, he also installed our solar system previously and once again he’s delivered an outstanding result. It’s rare to find someone so professional, reliable, and approachable. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with our energy setup.Looking forward to enjoying the benefits of our new home battery, and I can’t recommend Uncommon Solar highly enough to anyone considering solar or battery storage.

I can highly recommend Matt and Helen from Uncommon Solar.Over ten years ago Matt managed the installation of our panels and hooked them up to an Enphase inverter and fabulous enlighten software.Over those years we used enlighten to manage our power consumption to maximize self consumption. This reduced our bills but we still had lots of excess power which was wasted due to the almost zero feed in tariff.Early in July this year Matt added Enphase batteries to our System.Installation  was completed on the promised date and was smooth, problem free, and well-managed. Matt was professional, knowledgeable, and continues to provide excellent follow-up support.To top it off Matt and Helen recommended a great retail energy supply plan—our power bills are now down to just the daily supply charge!.Highly recommend!

We engaged Uncommon Solar to install a heat pump hot water service - the process and customer service have been exceptional! A provider that actually listened to our needs and didn't apply the smoke and mirrors approach experience with so many other providers. Tidy,hassle-free and on-time as arranged install. Highly recommended.

We recently had solar and a Tesla Powerwall 3 installed by Uncommon Solar, and the entire experience was absolutely outstanding from start to finish.From the first contact, Matt and Helen were professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about delivering a quality product and service. The pre-sales support was exceptional—they took the time to answer all our questions, explain the system in detail, and ensure we felt confident with our decision.Installation was prompt and seamless. The tradesmen were clearly highly skilled, respectful, and left the site spotless. Everything was explained thoroughly post-install, including how to use and monitor the Tesla app. Their attention to detail and customer care was second to none.What really sets Uncommon Solar apart is their after-sales service—responsive, supportive, and always happy to help with follow-ups.A huge thank you to Matt, Helen, and the entire Uncommon Solar team for such a smooth and professional experience. If you're considering solar or battery storage, don't look past these guys. Truly rare to find this level of care and quality these days.

Exceptional service from Matt, Helen and their installers, at Uncommon Solar. We wished to add a solar battery to our PV system, and received comprehensive, knowledgeable advice from Matt and regular communications from Helen. Installation was seamless and high quality. I highly recommend Uncommon Solar.

Uncommon Solar made this install so easy from design concept ensuring my needs were met to the install of what has turned out to be a quality product, we changed my old system from an AC Fronius GEN 24 to a DC sigenergy, the on site guys were on site when promised, carrying out the works both tidy and efficiently, i cannot recommend these highly enough.

Uncommon Solar installed our Tesla Powerwall 3 and Reclaim heat pump recently.The quoting and installation process were professional, fast and friendly.Customer service and after sales support have been exceptional.Overall, working with Uncommon Solar has been a fantastic experience, and I highly recommend them!

Matt and Helen of Uncommon Solar have a wealth of knowledge and years of experience in the solar industry.They have a great selection or solar panels, home batteries and energy efficient appliances and will work with you to get you the best possible outcome based on your individual needs.Numerous configurations available for the budget conscious and high-end users.Coupled with a raft of competent, efficient and reliable installers my experience with Uncommon Solar has been exemplary.After sales support has been terrific.Since the install Matt has worked with Enphase on my behalf to resolve a software issue after an update didn't go to plan.Highly recommended giving them a call

Open and transparent quotations. Great communication in a timely manner. Easy install that was done in the estimated timeframe. Very clean install. Very happy with system.Matt was able to build me a system that met my needs within my budget.

Matt was super helpful with my Reclaim Heat Pump which was installed about 2 years ago.The concrete slab which the tank sits on was not positioned flat on ground level. Possibly due to the weight of the tank, the slab has cracked, causing the tank to tilt. Over the past weeks, the amount of water released was abnormal like a running tap not small drips. Also the pressure release valve outlet was installed against the tank causing stain on the side of the tank over time.Matt provided useful advice on the issue and contacted Reclaim on my behalf. I was pleased to learn from Matt that Reclaim was going to reinstall the tank. 3 weeks passed and still not fixed, I contacted Matt who kindly followed up again with Reclaim. Then 3 days later, I have a confirmed date for the fix.Within the week, the Heat Pump tank was reinstalled, concrete slab was repositioned flat this time with another piece of new slab positioned on top of the previous slab. The PRV was checked and the outlet has also been diverted away from the tank.It looks and functions very well after the reinstallation. I was very pleased with the outcome and communicated that to Matt.Matt's simple respond was "I'm just Mr. Fix It." But really, isn't that all we want from all our engagements? Thank you Matt! You're a legend!Looking forward to working with you again on our solar battery plans!

Uncommon Solar have been an excellent company to deal with. Matt visited my property and discussed my solar panel and battery options in detail. He was concise and clear and made the selection process easy to understand. The quality of the products is excellent. Matt's team worked extremely well together, with excellent communication. The solar panels and battery were installed over 1 and 1/2 days on the days appointed. Punctuality, politeness and flexibilty were all excellent.All of the paperwork was handled efficiently by Helen in their office and anything I needed to fill out was sent immediately- solar panel loan and battery forms.Matt followed up after installation to make sure everything was as it should be and he has set up my solar app to make full use of my new solar energy.

Matt and team at Uncommon Solar were excellent.They removed my existing old system and took it all away so I didn’t have to worry about getting rid of it, they installed a 9.5kw solar system and Tesla Powerwall 3 as well.Their customer service from the very start was unmatched, they provided update information on they install and the quote/ sale, so I knew exactly what was going on from the start to the finish of the installation.They were very helpful with setting up the system and show me how to use the app and answered any question I had.Extremely happy with the whole process and would 100% recommend them to family and friends looking to get a solar system or battery system installed.

Matt and his team were excellent to deal with. They guided me away from another company that almost ripped me off, outlined my options, and installed a system that was extremely good value for money in a very reasonable timeframe. I would recommend them to anyone and everyone.

After comparing a couple of local solar battery installers was impressed by Uncommon Solar's approach and transparency. No hard sell, just information. Matt conducted the site inspection when he said he would and arranged for installation to take place on a day that suited our medical appointment schedule.Josh and the boys arrived on time and managed the installation without fuss, doing everything neatly in what is an older establishment, and cleaned up after themselves which was a much appreciated service.

Last year, Uncommon Solar impressed me with their initial quote for my PV panels and battery system, compared to other companies. They impressed me again by being able to begin and complete the entire installation ahead of schedule.Two months later, I ordered a further upgrade of our battery system which they were also able to install quickly and cleanly.One year later, I needed to use their services again to replace two panels that had been damaged by persons unknown. Again, working with them was prompt and professional, with the replacements being installed ahead of planned schedule.Most recently, one of my 25 micro-inverters failed but having this replaced promptly under warranty by Uncommon Solar was an absolute non-event.In today's stressed business climate, my dealings with Matt and Helen from Uncommon Solar can only be described as truly exceptional. If only all companies would treat their customers like this company does (especially post-purchase!)

We recently decommissioned our 14 year old 3kw system on our Warragul house and installed a new system comprising 10KW of panels and 13.5 KW Powerwall 3 batteryWe sought out Uncommon Solar for the full job and have been delighted with the entire process commencing with Matt’s appraisal of our home and advice about a suitable upgradeFrom there everything went like clockwork. The quote was very reasonable and the various stages of applications for the Govt rebates (while understandably bureaucratic including the need for stat decs etc) all proceeded smoothly tooAt all times we were advised of the next stages including the removal of old panels  (which I understand are to be recycled rather than be sent to landfill) - then the installation of new panels, battery and gateway by the electricians - and the subsequent visit by the electrical inspector - were all performed as per the schedule. Hence the system is now officially connected and up and runningFinally Matt made time to call by and check that our “settings” were correct and he explained the use of the Tesla app to monitor our use of the systemWe thoroughly endorse Uncommon Solar

Matt, Helen and the whole Uncommon Solar team have been a pleased to do business with. Matt came around and took the time to understand our situation,  suggested the best battery unit to support our existing solar set up and what would work best for us. Helen helped us along the way with our rebate application and then the installation crew were so professional.  Real pleasure doing business with the team.

Another great service from Uncommon Solar,  always professional and quality workmanship.Just had an additional Powerwall battery installed, all the crew from Uncommon Solar take pride in what they do and are very customer focused. I have had several dealing with them, from my initial Solar & battery install, then extra panels installed and now this additional battery.  Highly recommend Uncommon Solar, I have spent 46 years in the electrical industry and its refreshing to see old fashion values, quality and service across all the staff at Uncommon Solar.
